title: [AUG-69] Diagnostics: treat ffmpeg as mandatory, add install guidance
why_we_need_this: The diagnostics page (SetupGuide) classifies ffmpeg as optional ("OPT" label, "Not required" status when missing) and provides no installation help. In reality, ffmpeg is mandatory for all browser recordings — MediaRecorder outputs WebM, and whisper-cli only accepts WAV, so ensureWav() always needs ffmpeg. This caused a user to record a session, see diagnostics say everything is fine, and then hit a silent async transcription failure with "ffmpeg not found".
acceptance_criteria: 1. `SetupGuide.tsx`: Remove the "OPT" tag from the ffmpeg node label (remove `OPT`) 2. `SetupGuide.tsx`: Change the ffmpeg missing status from "Not required" to "Not installed" (line 244: `{ffmpegReady ? 'Available' : 'Not installed'}`) 3. `SetupGuide.tsx`: Update the HintPopup text from "Optional — most formats work without it" to something accurate, e.g. "Converts browser audio (WebM) to WAV for the whisper engine. Required for recording." 4. `SetupGuide.tsx`: Include ffmpeg in the `allReady` gate — change line 138 from `const allReady = whisperReady && modelReady;` to `const allReady = whisperReady && modelReady && ffmpegReady;` 5. `App.tsx`: Include ffmpeg in the `needsSetup` gate — add `|| !healthStatus.ffmpegAvailable` to the condition on lines 168-170 6. `SetupGuide.tsx`: Add an install guidance section (code block with copy button) for ffmpeg when it's missing but whisper+model are ready. Windows command: `winget install ffmpeg`. macOS: already covered by `brew install whisper-cpp ffmpeg`. 7. `SetupGuide.tsx`: Change the ffmpeg node circle color class from `diag-circle--green` to `diag-circle--yellow` (matching whisper node severity) to visually signal it's required, not auxiliary 8. Verify via `?diagnostics&mock=ffmpeg` that the diagnostics page shows ffmpeg as missing, blocks "Proceed", and displays the install command
